name: binhex-get-iplayer
description: get_iplayer has PVR-like capabilities (like Sky+ / TiVo / Series-Link); You can save lists of programme searches which are automatically recorded when they become available so that you can watch them when you choose and on devices that cannot run Adobe Flash Player - even if you don't have adequate broadband speeds or if your broadband streams too slowly at peak hours when you want to watch a programme.

paths.name: Path: /config
paths.description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

paths.name: Path: /data
paths.description: This is the container path to your downloaded files or user created content.

variables.name: Variable: INCOMPLETE_DOWNLOADS_PATH
variables.description: Specify the path to store get-iplayer incomplete downloads.

variables.name: Variable: COMPLETED_DOWNLOADS_PATH
variables.description: Specify the path to store get-iplayer completed downloads.

variables.name: Variable: VIDEO_SHOWS_NAME
variables.description: Specify the name of the video shows seperated by a comma to download e.g. 'EastEnders,BBC News'.

variables.name: Variable: VIDEO_SHOWS_PID
variables.description: Specify the PID of the video shows seperated by a comma to download e.g. 'm0020zpl,m0020jxw'.

variables.name: Variable: AUDIO_SHOWS_NAME
variables.description: Specify the name of the audio shows seperated by a comma to download e.g. 'radio 1's live lounge,radio 1 sound of 2025'.

variables.name: Variable: AUDIO_SHOWS_PID
variables.description: Specify the PID of the audio shows seperated by a comma to download e.g. 'p01029mq,p0k7bn64'.

variables.name: Variable: SCHEDULE
variables.description: Specify how often to check for new shows, e.g. '12h'.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
variables.description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
variables.description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
variables.description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

variables.name: Variable: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the running container

variables.name: Variable: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the running container
